sloka: अमृतम् प्रार्थयानस्य तत् ते भवतु मन्गलम् ।अमृतोत्पादने दैत्यान् घ्नतो वज्रधरस्य यत् ॥२-२५-३४॥
transliteration: amṛtam prārthayānasya tat te bhavatu mangalam ।amṛtotpādane daityān ghnato vajradharasya yat ॥2-25-34॥

translations.english: May you be bestowed with the same blessings conferred by Aditi on Indra, the wielder of thunder for the killing of daityas at the time nectar was generated
